scope: mGBA 0.10.5 source-only absolute-deadline, cyclesLate propagation, and equal-deadline Timer 0 receipt boundary

clock.absoluteScheduleFormula: mTimingScheduleAbsolute(W): mTimingSchedule(W - mTimingCurrentTime), therefore event.when = W
clock.duePredicate: mTimingTick dispatches root event when event.when - masterCycles <= 0
clock.callbackLateFormula: cyclesLate = -(event.when - masterCycles) = dispatchCurrentTime - event.when during GBAProcessEvents
clock.correctedDueFormula: during the GBA process-events tick, mTimingCurrentTime - cyclesLate = event.when
clock.callbackChargeRule: mTimingTick advances masterCycles only by its supplied cycles; callback bodies receive no automatic emulated-cycle charge
clock.processEventsRule: GBAProcessEvents clears cpu->cycles before mTimingTick and repeats mTimingTick while cpuBlocked; cpu->cycles is set to the next event while a DMA remains blocked

equalDeadlineOrdering.insertionRule: insert before an existing root only if its deadline is later, or its equal deadline has numerically greater priority
equalDeadlineOrdering.priorityRule: lower numeric priority runs first at an equal absolute deadline
equalDeadlineOrdering.equalPriorityRule: an equal-priority insertion walks past the existing event, preserving existing insertion order
equalDeadlineOrdering.callbackInsertionRule: a callback-created event uses the same root-list insertion; it can precede remaining higher-priority equal-deadline roots but cannot rerun callbacks already removed from the root
equalDeadlineOrdering.rerootRule: if mTimingInterrupt has moved the root to reroot, scheduling restores it; after the root drains mTimingTick restores reroot and recursively ticks zero cycles when its next event is already due

irq.propagation: GBARaiseIRQ marks IF, then GBATestIRQ schedules only when IE & IF is nonzero and no IRQ event is already scheduled: requested delta = 7 - cyclesLate, so an originating deadline D requests IRQ deadline D + 7
irq.caveat: an already scheduled IRQ is not moved; an overdue D + 7 IRQ remains ordered by its absolute deadline before priority is considered

video.propagation: _startHdraw and _startHblank reschedule their next phase with interval - cyclesLate, preserving the original phase deadline D + interval
video.dmaDeadlines: Vblank/Hblank/display-start callbacks pass -cyclesLate to DMA runners; those runners set dma.when = currentTime + 3 - cyclesLate = D + 3
video.irqDeadlines: VCount and Vblank IRQs pass cyclesLate and request D + 7; Hblank passes cyclesLate - 6 and requests D + 13

audioSample.propagation: _sample mixes at currentTime - cyclesLate = D, then schedules 1024 - cyclesLate, preserving deadline D + 1024
audioSample.relationToTimer0: the sample event does not call GBAAudioSampleFIFO; Timer 0 owns FIFO word consumption and custom FIFO-DMA requests

callbackOrder: reschedule the normal timer from currentTime - cyclesLate
raise a Timer 0 IRQ if its IRQ flag is set
timer0.normalReschedule: GBATimerUpdateRegister derives currentTime = mTimingCurrentTime - cyclesLate = D, aligns it, updates the register, and schedules the next absolute timer deadline from that corrected time
timer0.fifoDmaDeadline: for each qualifying FIFO, GBAAudioSampleFIFO stores dma.when = currentTime - cyclesLate = D and nextCount = 4 before GBADMASchedule/GBADMAUpdate schedules the shared DMA event
timer0.irqDeadline: if enabled and no IRQ event is already queued, Timer 0's GBARaiseIRQ path requests D + 7

dma.activeSelection: GBADMAUpdate scans DMA0 through DMA3; only a strictly earlier dma.when - currentTime replaces the active channel, so equal DMA deadlines retain the lower-numbered first channel
dma.timer0SameDeadline: two eligible Timer 0 FIFO requests have dma.when = D; DMA1 wins a DMA1/DMA2 tie, while the single GBA DMA event remains priority 64 behind equal-deadline IRQ/Video/Audio/Timer0 roots
dma.freshDispatch: _dmaEvent ignores cyclesLate; when nextCount == count it overwrites dma.when with actual mTimingCurrentTime, so a fresh DMA requested at D but dispatched late at T starts its service timeline at T, not D
dma.continuation: for a partially serviced DMA, _dmaEvent does not overwrite dma.when; GBADMAService advances that stored deadline by per-word timing and coalesces other overdue enabled DMA deadlines to it
dma.videoCompetition: Video Hblank/Vblank/display-start callbacks can create DMA deadlines D + 3, and GBADMAUpdate arbitrates them with Timer-originated and pre-existing DMA state

canTranslate: With a sampled Timer 0 event deadline D and its cyclesLate L, the callback's corrected scheduling time is D = dispatch current time - L.
Timer 0 normal rescheduling, a newly eligible Timer IRQ, FIFO custom-DMA request deadlines, Video phase rescheduling, and Audio Sample rescheduling can be translated to their source formulas above.
At one exact deadline, remaining registered callbacks are ordered IRQ, Video, Audio Sample, Timer 0, DMA; equal priorities retain prior insertion order.
A same-deadline fresh DMA1/DMA2 pair selects DMA1 first, subject to the shared DMA event and all active-DMA state.
cannotTranslate: There is no absolute Timer 0 service-completion timestamp from Timer 0's deadline and cyclesLate alone: FIFO eligibility, DMA registers, pre-existing DMA, Video-started DMA, and IRQ state determine the following root list.
A late fresh DMA does not preserve the Timer 0 request deadline; _dmaEvent resets its service when to actual dispatch current time, so a receipt must record both request and DMA-dispatch times.
A partially serviced or repeated DMA has different deadline semantics, including overdue coalescing; its count, nextCount, when, source, destination, register mode, and active channel are required.
Do not fit a fixed Timer 0 callback/service constant or wire serviceCostMasterCycles from this receipt.
minimumRuntimeFields: Timer 0 event.when, dispatch mTimingCurrentTime, and cyclesLate
ordered due roots with event name, absolute when, priority, and insertion sequence
Timer 0 reload/control/lastEvent and FIFO A/B routing, pointers, and internalRemaining
Video phase and DMA/IRQ enable state, Audio Sample deadline, IE/IF/IME, and whether IRQ/DMA events were already scheduled
